from pathlib import Path
import json,re

task='DEV-PRED-ASTRA-AUTONOMOUS-REVIEWER-FIRSTFAIL-20261005'
candidates=[
    Path.home()/'.local/state/prediction-project-executor'/f'{task}.json',
    Path.home()/'prediction_research_prod'/'control/results'/task/'RESULT.json',
    Path.home()/'prediction_research_prod'/'control/results'/task/'stdout.log',
    Path.home()/'prediction_research_prod'/'control/results'/task/'stderr.log',
]
print('DIAG_TASK='+task)
for p in candidates:
    print('PATH='+str(p)+' EXISTS='+str(p.exists()))
    if not p.exists() or not p.is_file():
        continue
    try:
        text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
    except Exception as exc:
        print('READ_ERROR='+repr(exc));continue
    print('SIZE='+str(len(text)))
    lines=text.splitlines()
    interesting=[ln for ln in lines if re.search(r'(FAILED|FAILURES|ERROR|AssertionError|E\s+|short test summary|Traceback|pytest)',ln)]
    print('INTERESTING_BEGIN')
    for ln in interesting[-120:]:
        print(ln[:2000])
    print('INTERESTING_END')
    print('TAIL_BEGIN')
    for ln in lines[-220:]:
        print(ln[:2000])
    print('TAIL_END')
